Obeya er et visuelt rom for samarbeid me: Obeya is a visual room for collaboration between the different functions of an organisation. Obeya is an architecture for radically better collaboration across boundaries.
Lærebøker sendes ut når dere har meldt d: Textbooks are sent out when you have registered. All material is available on a dedicated course portal 24/7. Certificates are presented at the Lean conference in September.
Dette er læreboka i TKL/TQM ved flere hø: This is the Total Quality Management textbook at several Norwegian colleges and universities. Here you will also find many resources for teaching quality management.
På fagseminarer lærer vi om Obeya og del: At our seminars we learn about Obeya and share experience between organisations. We are only at the start of this next Lean journey, which will give us dramatically better learning.
Ved å visualisere (se sammen), reflekter: By visualizing (seeing together), reflecting and trying out solutions, we learn faster and waste less time on papers sent back and forth. Obeya is also the room for developing a better understanding of systems: better systems thinking.
Mer enn noen gang trenger vi å forbedre: More than ever, we need to improve the quality of our leadership. Learning leadership sets off a chain reaction of improvement and learning. Every organisation is a "complex adaptive system" where faster learning together is the key to success. It starts with how we think: developing mental models that are closer to how reality really is. This course is about understanding systems, and understanding and improving our thinking.
Kurset gir deg et betydelig løft videre,: The course takes you a significant step further: personally, because you think better and more consciously, and for your organisation, because your leadership has far greater impact. As on earlier Lean courses, we link learning to the real challenges you face, so the course works twice over. All participants have several years of Lean and continuous improvement in their own organisations. The Trippel L programme aims to release potential in you and your colleagues that you hardly thought possible.
Programmet er et samarbeid mellom Instit: The programme is a collaboration between the Institute for Learning Organisations and Flowit. Its content was developed partly through a "PhD" programme Bjarne Berg Wig completed with the Cabrera Research Lab in Boston, and partly through two R&D programmes supported by the Research Council of Norway. The first programme (2020–2022) produced a method for identifying strong adaptive learning cultures (the LOS mirror). The second, ALIOS (accelerated learning in organisations and society), is developing methods for greater thinking maturity, systems thinking and systems leadership, drawing on the world's leading research in the field. Guest lecturers come from the ALIOS R&D team: Sidsel W. Storaas, Johannes Borge, Kari Heggholmen, Einar Jørgensen and John Richard Hansen.
